title: apex.case.events
description: Case lifecycle event emitted by services/regulatory-svc/cases on every state transition. Aligned 2026-04-27 with the live emitter shape (the original draft pre-dated the implementation and used different field names — see logs/orchestrator.md). v1 had no registered Glue resource yet, so the rewrite happened in-place rather than as a v2 bump. 2026-05-03 (T4.19): event_type enum extended with cas_submitted/cas_reviewed/cap_proposed/cap_approved/cap_closed for the BAC-A Causal Analysis + Corrective Action Plan flow.

event_id.description: Unique id for this event; format `evt_<base36-ms>_<hex4>`.

ts.description: Time the transition was committed (cases service clock).

case_id.description: Deterministic UUIDv5-style id (alert_id + customer_id). Stable across EWS<->Collection.

payload.description: Event-type-specific payload. Free-form to allow per-event-type evolution without schema bumps; consumers should be tolerant of unknown keys.
